# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: The Zephyr integration is spoken of AS a lock mechanism — 'unlock' treats the integration as a key that released something previously closed, a thing-as-thing metaphor.
Velocity framed as a peak achievement — standing and mastery appealed to in the same breath.
Naming an integration as the decisive capability that enabled delivery — a mastery claim.
Past-tense verb naming a completed, specific deliverable.
Past-tense reporting of a measured, actual velocity figure.
Past-tense attribution naming a specific integration as the causal factor.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Straightforward declarative of accomplishment delivered in neutral register — satisfaction without energized delivery.
Superlative marks quiet pride in the achievement, but the flat declarative register keeps arousal low.
Positive evaluative phrase signals settled satisfaction with the integration's value, delivered without energized markers.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Speaker supplies a factual accomplishment statement — controlling the facts of what was delivered, no influence attempt on a listener.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Speaker supplies measured performance data — informational control of the facts, no overt influence tactic.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Speaker asserts a causal claim about what drove success — supplying interpretive facts, no influence attempt directed at another.
Past-tense performed declarative recording a settled, load-bearing outcome the speaker expects others to recognize — ratification of a completed action, not an argued position.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Flat unhedged factual assertion ready to defend but moveable with evidence; no ratification language or performed settling to lift it to decision.
Committed causal assertion stated with conviction but still an argued position rather than a ratified settlement; no performed-act or operational language to reach decision.
Native pipeline jargon ('unlock') used as a causal metaphor for integration value — a technical register signal against the document's plain-spoken baseline.
The 'we' enacts communal-sharing — the team as one undifferentiated body that shipped together.
Velocity measured in points and ranked against quarterly performance enacts market-pricing — proportionality and quantified output.
Framing an integration as the proportional lever that unlocked value enacts market-pricing — cost-benefit attribution to a single causal factor.

payload.rationale: The document is a sprint retro covering three concepts: the shipped async decision widget, 23-point velocity, and Zephyr integration as key unlock. I expanded the focus-surfaced witnesses (Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Obs_TinaVelocity, Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor, Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved) plus the two load-bearing narratives the widget embodies (Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus) and their child positions (Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform) that frame the product category the widget instantiates. I deliberately did NOT expand Position_PricingTwelveDollars or Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams because the document text touches neither pricing nor target market.

Witness-depth sections below already carry full provenance.

Deciding where to go: each mapped area's narration tells you the SPAN of what lives under it; the area index names everything else. Expand a subtree when its narration (or name) shows your subject plausibly lives there — you'll get the trajectory, the variants, and the verbatim witness. positions.name: Sprint4QuantifiedSuccessEvidence
positions.frame: what counts as evidence that the sprint delivered on the product's core promise?
positions.why: src-2 and src-3 both operate at the 'claim' conviction level (argued, quantitatively anchored assertions rather than settled ratifications) and both enact a market-pricing relational frame — velocity points and a named integration are each offered as the proportional cause of the sprint's success. They read together as the evidence layer justifying the retro's success narrative. This is held in tension with src-1, which sits at 'decision' conviction (a flat ratified statement of a completed act, communal-sharing framed via 'We shipped') and is not folded into this group — the gradient from ratified accomplishment to argued causal/quantitative claims is a genuine seam, not noise, so the two claim-level statements are read apart from the settled shipping statement.

placements.why: All three segments report on the sprint that delivered the decision-capture-at-consensus feature: src-1 names the shipped artifact ('async decision widget') that IS the capture mechanism this leaf names; src-3 names the Zephyr integration as the technical enabler that lets capture happen 'without separate plugins' across chat surfaces, i.e. the zero-extra-steps linkage this leaf's narration describes; src-2's velocity figure is the quantified proof point offered for the same claim (echoed by Position_Sprint4ThesisProven's 'this sprint proved the thesis' framing of the identical event) rather than a theme of its own — per the grain test it is a fact that evidences this leaf, not a leaf itself. No existing leaf names 'execution velocity' or 'integration enablement' as a standalone subject future envelopes would keep feeding independent of this capture-at-consensus theme, so these join here rather than minting.
